items.title: United States: A Pentagon assessment finds that US strikes targeting the Houthis killed 153 civilians in Yemen over the past year.
Colombia: A magnitude 7.4 earthquake hits Chocó Department, killing 331 people.
Israel: The United Nations Middle East envoy says the conflict has killed over 200 Palestinians and nearly 30 Israelis this year, surpassing the previous year.
Flash flooding continues for the fourth day in Kamdesh District, Nuristan Province, killing several more people and bringing the death toll to 113.
Lebanon: Lebanon marked one-year anniversary since the 2020 Beirut explosion which killed more than 200 people.
Federal Reserve rate decision: cut by 0.25 point, to a 2.00-2.25% target range (effective 2019-08-01)

Turkey has killed around 260 members of the Kurdistan Workers' Party in recent bombing campaigns in Turkey and northern Iraq. Officially the operation was started to attack ISIL but over 90% of attacks were against the PKK.
More than 142 people are killed across the country in a continuing crackdown on protests.
Floods in northeastern China kill more than 100 people and sweep 3,000 chemical-filled barrels into the Songhua River.
China: Floods in northeastern China kill more than 100 people and sweep 3,000 chemical-filled barrels into the Songhua River.

At least 28 people die in Uttar Pradesh, India as an overcrowded boat carrying flood evacuees and aid workers capsizes on the Rohni River. Monsoon floods have killed more than 150 people in India during July while at least 82 people have died in Nepal over the past two weeks and 38 in Bangladesh.
Over 311 people are killed and 276 injured in a fire which swept a market in Asunción, Paraguay.
Hurricane Douglas (1996) peaked at Category 4, 115-knot winds and 946 hPa
